title: Robert N. Stavins (1948–)
venue: In: Palgrave Companion to Harvard Economics
abstract: Robert N. Stavins is a leading environmental economist whose research and policy engagement have shaped a generation of environmental policies. His work has been critical to the development and widespread use of market-based approaches to environmental problems, to the non-partisan use of benefit–cost analysis in environmental policy, and most recently for economic-based approaches to climate change. In addition to his scholarship, Rob’s engagement with Congress, the US Environmental Protection Agency, and the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change have come to define the Harvard Kennedy School model of policy-engaged scholarship and research-informed engagement.
abstract_zh: 罗伯特·N·斯塔温斯（Robert N. Stavins）是一位杰出的环境经济学家，其研究与政策参与塑造了一代环境政策。他的工作对于市场化方法在环境问题上的发展与广泛应用、环境政策中对成本收益分析的非党派使用，以及近来针对气候变化的经济学方法，都至关重要。除了学术研究之外，他与国会、美国环境保护署以及政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）的互动，也界定了哈佛肯尼迪政府学院以政策参与为导向的学术研究和以研究为依据的参与模式。

title: Does Information Disclosure Reduce Drinking Water Violations in the United States?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: The 1996 Safe Drinking Water Act Amendments required community water systems to disclose violations of drinking water standards to their customers in annual water quality reports. We explore the impact of three methods of disclosure on health-based drinking water quality violations using a matching and differences-in-differences framework with a national data set of drinking water quality violations from 1990 to 2001. We find that this information disclosure requirement reduced drinking water violations significantly and that the primary effect of disclosure on violations persists for at least four years after policy implementation. We find no evidence, however, that water systems trade these potentially more salient violation reductions for potentially less salient reductions in violations of other standards, nor do we find any evidence that water systems responded differentially to disclosure based on the demographic or political characteristics of their customers.
abstract_zh: 1996年《安全饮用水法》修正案要求社区供水系统在年度水质报告中向用户披露饮用水标准的违规情况。我们利用一个全国性的饮用水质量违规数据集（时间跨度为1990年至2001年），采用匹配与双重差分框架，考察了三种披露方式对基于健康的饮用水质量违规的影响。我们发现，这一信息披露要求显著减少了饮用水违规情况，并且披露对违规行为的主要影响在政策实施后至少持续了四年。然而，我们没有发现证据表明，供水系统会将这些可能更为显著的违规减少，换取其他标准下可能较不显著的违规减少；我们也没有发现证据表明，供水系统根据用户的人口或政治特征，对披露作出了不同的反应。

title: Energy Justice, Decarbonization, and the Clean Energy Transformation
venue: Annual Review of Resource Economics
abstract: Addressing climate change will require significant reductions in carbon emissions. Decarbonization will likely lead to increases in energy prices, which are regressive. Poorer households spend a higher percentage of income on energy and also have less access to energy efficient options in housing, transportation (including electric vehicles), and household durables. This review summarizes the state of knowledge on the energy justice implications of the clean energy transformation along four dimensions—production of energy, energy insecurity/energy poverty, access to clean energy technologies, and impacts of policy instrument choices for achieving decarbonization. Along each dimension there is evidence of greater negative impacts on lower-income households and on Black, Indigenous, and people of color (BIPOC) households, even controlling for income. But there is also evidence that these impacts can be mitigated through policy choices. Together these findings highlight that centering justice concerns in policy debates is critical for a just and clean energy transformation.
abstract_zh: 应对气候变化需要大幅减少碳排放。去碳化可能导致能源价格上涨，而能源价格上涨具有累退性。较贫困的家庭将收入中更高的比例用于能源支出，同时也较难获得住房、交通（包括电动汽车）和家用耐用品中的节能选项。本综述总结了关于清洁能源转型的能源公正影响的知识现状，涵盖四个维度：能源生产、能源不安全/能源贫困、清洁能源技术的可获得性，以及为实现去碳化而选择政策工具的影响。在每个维度上，都有证据表明，即使控制了收入因素，低收入家庭以及黑人、原住民和有色人种（BIPOC）家庭所受的负面影响更大。但也有证据表明，这些影响可以通过政策选择加以缓解。综合来看，这些发现表明，在政策辩论中将公正关切置于核心位置，对于实现公正且清洁的能源转型至关重要。

title: Institutional Roles and Goals for Retrospective Regulatory Analysis
venue: Journal of Benefit Cost Analysis
abstract: Despite repeated calls for retrospective regulatory review by every President since the 1970s, progress on implementing such reviews has been slow. We argue that part of the explanation for the slow progress to date stems from misalignment between the goals of regulatory review and the institutional framework used for the review. We define three distinct goals of regulatory review - the rule relevance goal, the rule improvement goal, and the regulatory learning goal. We then examine the text of the Presidential Executive Orders and major Congressional legislation addressing retrospective review, and document which goals were targeted and which institutions were used to conduct the reviews. We find that the U.S. federal government has almost always sought review of one rule at a time, conducted by the agency that issued or promulgated the rule and that these reviews tend to focus on rule relevance and costs. This institutional framework for retrospective review - one rule, assessed by the promulgating agency, focused on relevance and cost - is only well-suited to a narrow interpretation of the rule improvement goal. We then review alternative institutional structures that could better meet the rule improvement goal and the broader regulatory learning goal across multiple rules and agencies, and we offer recommendations for developing new guidance and institutions to promote multiagency regulatory learning.

title: Economic analysis, risk regulation, and the dynamics of policy regret
venue: In: Policy Shock Recalibrating Risk and Regulation After Oil Spills Nuclear Accidents and Financial Crises
abstract: Regulatory analytical requirements (e.g., cost-benefit and cost-effectiveness analysis) have been established incrementally during the last 40 to 50 years through a series of presidential and congressional initiatives. The current set of requirements includes Executive Order 12866 and Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Circular A-4, the Regulatory Flexibility Act (RFA), and the Unfunded Mandates Reform Act (UMRA).These requirements vary in terms of the agencies and rules they cover, and the types of analyses that are required. For example, a regulatory analysis under the Regulatory Flexibility Act is not required if the agency head certifies that the rule will not have a "significant economic impact on a substantial number of small entities."The most extensive and broadly applicable of the requirements are in Executive Order 12866 and OMB Circular A-4, but they do not apply to independent regulatory agencies. The statutes that provide rulemaking authority to independent regulatory agencies often require them to "consider" regulatory costs and benefits, and they often have less explicit requirements for cost-benefit analysis, if any. An OMB report indicated that independent regulatory agencies provided some information and costs and benefits in 76 of the 118 major rules they issued from FY2003 to FY2012.Cabinet departments and other agencies estimated monetary costs and benefits for some, but not all, of their rules. Several bills have been introduced in the 113 th Congress that would codify and/or expand the current requirements for cost-benefit analysis. Congress could decide to keep the existing analytical framework in place, or could enact one or more of these reform proposals. Another more comprehensive approach could be to consolidate all of the analytical requirements in one place, and perhaps expand those requirements to include more agencies or rules, or to require different types of analysis. To do so, or to simply cover independent regulatory agencies by the executive order, the President could arguably amend Executive Order 12866 and OMB Circular A-4, or Congress could enact legislation. Any such changes must be cognizant of the state of existing law and practice in this area, and the resources and data required for agencies to carry out the analyses.1 See, for example, Tammy O. Tengs and John D. Graham, "The Opportunity Costs of Haphazard Social Investments in Life-Saving," in Risks, Costs, and Lives Saved: Getting Better Results from Regulation, Robert W. Hahn, ed.
abstract_zh: 管制分析的要求（例如成本收益分析和成本效益分析）是在过去40至50年间，通过一系列总统和国会的举措逐步建立起来的。目前的要求包括第12866号行政命令、管理和预算办公室（OMB）第A-4号通告、《规制灵活性法》（RFA）以及《无资金授权改革法》（UMRA）。这些要求在所涵盖的机构和规则以及所要求的分析类型上各不相同。例如，若机构负责人证明某项规则不会对大量小型实体产生“显著的经济影响”，则无需依据《规制灵活性法》进行管制分析。覆盖范围最广、适用面最宽的要求见于第12866号行政命令和OMB第A-4号通告，但它们不适用于独立管制机构。授予独立管制机构规则制定权的法规通常要求其“考虑”管制成本和收益，而这些法规对成本收益分析的明确要求通常较少，甚至没有。一份OMB报告显示，在2003财年至2012财年间独立管制机构发布的118项重大规则中，有76项提供了部分信息以及成本和收益。内阁各部门和其他机构对部分（但并非全部）规则的货币化成本和收益进行了估计。第113届国会已提出多项法案，旨在将现行的成本收益分析要求法典化和/或扩大其范围。国会可以决定维持现有的分析框架，也可以颁布上述一项或多项改革提案。另一种更为全面的方法，是将所有分析要求集中到一处，并可能扩大其覆盖的机构或规则范围，或要求进行不同类型的分析。若要做到这一点，或仅仅通过行政命令将独立管制机构纳入覆盖范围，总统或许可以修订第12866号行政命令和OMB第A-4号通告，或者国会可以立法。任何此类修改都必须充分考虑该领域现有法律与实践的状况，以及机构开展分析所需的资源和数据。1 参见例如Tammy O. Tengs和John D. Graham，“The Opportunity Costs of Haphazard Social Investments in Life-Saving”，载于Robert W. Hahn编，《Risks, Costs, and Lives Saved: Getting Better Results from Regulation》。

title: Fleet behavior is responsive to a large-scale environmental disturbance: Hypoxia effects on the spatial dynamics of the northern Gulf of Mexico shrimp fishery
venue: PloS one
abstract: The northwestern Gulf of Mexico shelf experiences one of the largest seasonal hypoxic zones in the western hemisphere. Hypoxia (dissolved oxygen, DO ≤ 2.0 mg·L-1) is most severe from May to August during the height of the Gulf shrimp fishery, but its effects on the fishery are not well known. Prior studies indicate that hypoxia alters the spatial dynamics of shrimp and other species through habitat loss and aggregation in nearby oxygenated refuge habitats. We hypothesized that hypoxia-induced changes in the distribution of shrimp also alter the spatial dynamics of the Gulf shrimp fleet. We integrated data on the geographic distribution of shrimp tows and bottom DO to evaluate the effects of hypoxia on spatial patterns in shrimping effort. Our analyses indicate that shrimping effort declines in low DO waters on both the Texas and Louisiana shelf, but that considerable effort still occurs in low DO waters off Louisiana, likely because riverine nutrients fuel both benthic production and low bottom DO in the same general regions. The response of the shrimp fleet to hypoxia on the Louisiana shelf was complex with shifts in effort inshore, offshore, westward, and eastward of the hypoxic zone, as well as to an oxygenated area between two hypoxia regimes associated with the Mississippi and the Atchafalaya River outflows. In contrast, effort on the Texas shelf mostly shifted offshore in response to low DO but also shifted inshore in some years. Spatial patterns in total shrimping effort were driven primarily by the number of shrimp tows, consistent with aggregation of the fleet outside of hypoxic waters, though tow duration also declined in low DO waters. Overall, our results demonstrate that hypoxia alters the spatial dynamics of the Gulf shrimp fishery with potential consequences for harvest interactions and the economic condition of the fishery.
abstract_zh: 墨西哥湾西北部大陆架是西半球最大的季节性缺氧区之一。缺氧（溶解氧，DO≤2.0 mg·L-1）在5月至8月墨西哥湾虾类渔业最旺盛的时期最为严重，但其对渔业的影响尚不为人所熟知。先前的研究表明，缺氧通过栖息地丧失以及在附近含氧避难栖息地的聚集，改变了虾类及其他物种的空间动态。我们假设，缺氧引起的虾类分布变化同时也改变了墨西哥湾虾船队的空间动态。我们整合了虾拖网地理分布数据和底层溶解氧数据，以评估缺氧对捕虾努力量空间格局的影响。分析表明，在得克萨斯州和路易斯安那州的大陆架上，低溶解氧水域中的捕虾努力量都有所下降，但在路易斯安那州近海的低溶解氧水域中仍有相当可观的捕捞努力，这可能是因为河流营养物质在大致相同的区域同时促进了底栖生产和底层低溶解氧。路易斯安那大陆架上虾船队对缺氧的反应较为复杂：努力量向近岸、离岸、缺氧区以西和以东转移，同时也向密西西比河与阿查法拉亚河出流所形成的两个缺氧区之间的一片含氧区域转移。相比之下，得克萨斯大陆架上的努力量主要因低溶解氧而向离岸转移，但在某些年份也向近岸转移。捕捞努力总量的空间格局主要由虾拖网的数量驱动，这与船队向缺氧水域之外聚集的情况相一致，不过拖网持续时间在低溶解氧水域中也有所下降。总体而言，我们的结果表明，缺氧改变了墨西哥湾虾类渔业的空间动态，并可能对渔获物的相互作用及渔业的经济状况产生影响。

title: Institutional Mechanisms for Investigating the Regulatory Implications of a Major Crisis: The Commission of Inquiry and the Safety Board
venue: In: Policy Shock: Regulatory Responses to Nuclear Accidents, Offshore Oil Spill, and Financial Crises

title: Introduction
venue: In: Policy Shock Recalibrating Risk and Regulation After Oil Spills Nuclear Accidents and Financial Crises
abstract: After more than a generation of deregulation and a presidential declaration that the “era of big government is over,” the political pendulum has apparently begun to swing back toward regulation. Calls for effective government action, long subdued, have grown louder and more numerous. The provocations are not hard to find: the financial crisis first and foremost, but also accounting scandals at some of the nation's largest corporations (Enron, WorldCom, etc.); lead-tainted toys from China; E. coli outbreaks in the domestic food supply; collapsing levees and bridges; rising global temperatures and the threat of fundamental climate change. One might expect that American lawmakers, confronted by these many challenges, could turn to experts in the academy for guidance. Yet to a surprisingly large extent, the academic discussion has remained stuck in a deregulatory mindset, more focused on government failure than on the ingredients of government effectiveness or success. As a result, there is a real danger that the new round of regulation will be rooted not in new research and new thinking, but rather in old ideas that are conveniently dusted off and reused in the absence of anything better. This book represents an attempt by concerned academics to begin moving beyond old ideas about regulation – very old ones that informed earlier rounds of regulatory activity as well as more recent ones that drove a wave of deregulation beginning in the late 1970s.
abstract_zh: 在经历了一代人的放松管制、以及一位总统宣布“大政府时代已经结束”之后，政治钟摆显然已开始重新摆向管制一侧。长期受到压抑的、要求政府采取有效行动的呼声，变得越来越响亮，也越来越多。诱因并不难找：首先是金融危机，还有一些美国最大企业的会计丑闻（安然、世通等）；来自中国的含铅玩具；国内食品供应中的大肠杆菌疫情；垮塌的堤坝和桥梁；不断上升的全球气温以及根本性气候变化的威胁。人们或许会预期，面对这些诸多挑战，美国立法者可以向学术界寻求指导。然而，在相当大的程度上，学术讨论仍然停留在放松管制的思维之中，更关注政府失灵，而较少关注政府有效性或成功的要素。因此，存在一种真实的危险：新一轮的管制将不是植根于新的研究和新的思想，而是植根于旧观念——在缺乏更好选择的情况下，这些旧观念被方便地重新拿出来使用。本书代表了一群关切此事的学者所作的尝试，旨在开始超越关于管制的旧观念——既包括早先几轮管制活动所依据的非常古老的观念，也包括自20世纪70年代末起推动放松管制浪潮的较为晚近的观念。

title: Recalibrating risk: Crises, learning, and regulatory change
venue: In: Policy Shock Recalibrating Risk and Regulation After Oil Spills Nuclear Accidents and Financial Crises
abstract: It is often observed that crisis events spur new regulation. An extensive literature focuses on the role of disasters, tragedies, scandals, shocks, and other untoward events in stimulating regulatory responses (Baumgartner and Jones 1993; Percival 1998; Kuran and Sunstein 1999; Birkland 2006; Repetto 2006; Wiener and Richman 2010; Wuthnow 2010). We have highlighted numerous examples of arguably crisis-driven regulation in the introductory chapter (Balleisen et al., this volume) and in the several case study chapters in this book. The notion that crises spur regulation has become a “commonplace assertion,” and yet one that is “so widely held … that it remains virtually unexamined in empirical and historical analyses” (Carpenter and Sin 2007, 149). Observing this relationship does not itself explain what causal mechanisms may be driving it (Carpenter and Sin 2007, 154). And the relationship does not always hold (Kahn 2007). We do not claim that all crises spur regulatory change, nor that all regulatory changes arise from crises. Some crisis events do not produce significant regulatory change – perhaps including mass shootings in the United States, and Hurricanes Katrina and Sandy. Some regulatory changes occur without preceding crisis events – such as the Acid Rain Program of the 1990 Clean Air Act. This volume has sought to enrich the empirical understanding of how the process of crisis stimulus and regulatory response unfolds. Our main question has been not whether, but rather how, regulatory systems change in response to crises. Going beyond the generic assertion that crises spur regulation, we have explored diverse ways in which regulatory change may play out: how different types of regulatory responses may follow from different kinds of crises. In this volume, we have studied a set of cases in which some regulatory change typically did follow a crisis event, in order to understand how that process led to different types of regulatory changes in different contexts. The case studies in this volume – focusing on oil spills, nuclear power accidents, and financial crashes, with regulatory responses in the United States, Europe, and Japan – illustrate a wide array of crises, institutions, actors, countries, time periods, and policy changes.
abstract_zh: 人们常常观察到，危机事件会推动新的管制。大量文献关注灾难、悲剧、丑闻、冲击以及其他不幸事件在激发管制反应中的作用（Baumgartner and Jones 1993；Percival 1998；Kuran and Sunstein 1999；Birkland 2006；Repetto 2006；Wiener and Richman 2010；Wuthnow 2010）。我们在导论章节（Balleisen等，本卷）以及本书的若干案例研究章节中，列举了大量可论证为危机驱动的管制实例。危机会推动管制变革的观点已成为一种“常识性论断”，然而这一观点“被如此广泛地持有……以至于它在经验和历史分析中几乎从未受到检验”（Carpenter and Sin 2007, 149）。观察到这种关系本身，并不能解释可能驱动这种关系的因果机制（Carpenter and Sin 2007, 154）。而且，这种关系并不总是成立（Kahn 2007）。我们并不主张所有危机都会推动管制变革，也不主张所有管制变革都源于危机。一些危机事件并未带来显著的管制变革——可能包括美国的大规模枪击事件，以及卡特里娜和桑迪飓风。也有一些管制变革在危机事件之前就已发生，例如1990年《清洁空气法》中的酸雨计划。本卷旨在丰富关于危机刺激与管制反应过程如何展开的经验认识。我们的主要问题不是管制体系是否会因危机而变化，而是它们如何变化。超越“危机推动管制”这一泛泛的论断，我们探究了管制变革可能展开的多种方式：不同类型的危机如何导致不同类型的管制反应。在本卷中，我们研究了一组案例，在这些案例中，危机事件通常确实伴随着某些管制变革，目的是理解这一过程如何在不同背景下导致不同类型的管制变革。本卷的案例研究聚焦于石油泄漏、核电事故和金融崩溃，涉及美国、欧洲和日本的管制反应，展示了广泛的危机类型、制度、行为主体、国家、时间段和政策变革。

title: Seafood prices reveal impacts of a major ecological disturbance
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
abstract: Coastal hypoxia is a growing problem worldwide, but economic consequences for fisheries are largely unknown. We provide evidence that hypoxia causes economic effects on a major fishery that was once the most valuable fishery in America. Our analysis is also a breakthrough in causal inference for coupled human-natural systems. Although establishing causality with observational data is always challenging, feedbacks across the human and natural systems amplify these challenges and explain why linking hypoxia to fishery losses has been elusive. We offer an alternative approach using a market counterfactual that is immune to contamination from feedbacks in the coupled system. Natural resource prices can thus be a means to assess the significance of an ecological disturbance.
abstract_zh: 沿海缺氧问题在全球范围内日益严重，但其对渔业的经济后果在很大程度上仍不为人所知。我们提供证据表明，缺氧对一个曾经是美国价值最高的渔业产生了经济影响。我们的分析在耦合人类—自然系统的因果推断方面也具有突破性意义。尽管利用观测数据确立因果关系始终具有挑战性，但人类系统与自然系统之间的反馈放大了这些挑战，并解释了为何将缺氧与渔业损失联系起来一直难以实现。我们提供了一种替代方法，利用一个市场反事实，使其免受耦合系统中反馈的干扰。因此，自然资源价格可以成为评估生态扰动重要性的一种手段。

title: Spillovers in regional fisheries management: Do catch shares cause leakage?
venue: Land Economics
abstract: Open Access Copy (Duke) Regional councils manage U.S. fisheries. Fishermen can participate in fisheries managed by multiple councils, and effort controls in one region could lead to effort leakage into another. Theoretical modeling demonstrates that positive, negative, and no leakage are possible. Using difference-in-differences, we test for leakage across regional boundaries for a catch share program in New England and find evidence that the New England groundfish sector program caused spillover into adjacent Mid-Atlantic fisheries. Aggregate Mid-Atlantic harvest volume increased among sector members after the policy change. We find leakage in individual fisheries with similar gear and high market substitutability with sector species.
abstract_zh: 开放获取版本（杜克大学）。区域理事会管理美国的渔业。渔民可以参与由多个理事会管理的渔业，一个区域的捕捞努力控制可能导致捕捞努力泄漏到另一个区域。理论模型表明，正向泄漏、负向泄漏以及无泄漏都是可能的。我们利用双重差分方法，检验了新英格兰一项渔获份额（catch share）计划是否造成了跨区域边界的泄漏，发现新英格兰底层鱼类船组计划导致了溢出效应，溢入了相邻的中大西洋渔业。政策变化后，船组成员的中大西洋总捕获量有所增加。我们在使用相似渔具且与船组鱼种具有高度市场替代性的个别渔业中，发现了泄漏现象。

title: Offshore oil and gas drilling: A review of regulatory regimes in the United States, United Kingdom, and Norway
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This article investigates the regulatory regimes for offshore oil and gas in the United States (U.S.), United Kingdom (U.K.), and Norway from both a positive and normative perspective. The positive analysis reveals that all three countries are converging on a similar regulatory system that combines strict liability, command-and-control, and management-based regulations for controlling site-specific risks. The timing of the adoption of each element in this regulatory system varies across the three countries and has been driven largely by accidents along the individual country’s continental shelf. In particular, the adoption of the management-based approach occurred after a significant accident revealed the weaknesses of a one-size-fits–all set of prescriptive rules. Although the normative analysis reveals theoretical support for the use of both liability and management-based approaches, the empirical data are limited, and the data that do exist call into question the superiority of the management-based approach over command-and-control. More research is needed that develops and systematically evaluates incentive-compatible regulatory regimes. (JEL: Q38, Q40, Q48, K32)
abstract_zh: 本文从实证和规范两个角度考察了美国、英国和挪威的海上油气监管制度。实证分析表明，三国正在趋同于一套相似的监管体系，该体系结合了严格责任、命令—控制型以及基于管理的监管，用以控制特定场址的风险。该监管体系中各项要素的采用时间在三国之间各不相同，并且在很大程度上是由各国大陆架上发生的事故所推动的。特别是，基于管理的监管方式是在一起重大事故暴露出“一刀切”的规定性规则体系的缺陷之后才被采用的。尽管规范分析从理论上支持采用严格责任和基于管理的两种方式，但实证数据有限，而现有数据对基于管理的方式是否优于命令—控制型提出了质疑。仍需开展更多研究，以构建并系统评估具有激励相容性的监管制度。（JEL: Q38, Q40, Q48, K32）

title: Evolution of households' responses to the groundwater arsenic crisis in Bangladesh: information on environmental health risks can have increasing behavioral impact over time
venue: Environment and development economics
abstract: A national campaign of well testing through 2003 enabled households in rural Bangladesh to switch, at least for drinking water, from high-arsenic wells to neighboring lower arsenic wells. We study the well-switching dynamics over time by re-interviewing, in 2008, a randomly selected subset of households in the Araihazar region who had been interviewed in 2005. Contrary to concerns that the impact of arsenic information on switching behavior would erode over time, we find that not only was 2003–2005 switching highly persistent but also new switching by 2008 doubled the share of households at unsafe wells who had switched. The passage of time also had a cost: 22 per cent of households did not recall test results by 2008. The loss of arsenic knowledge led to staying at unsafe wells and switching from safe wells. Our results support ongoing well testing for arsenic to reinforce this beneficial information.
abstract_zh: 2003年前的全国性水井检测运动使孟加拉国农村家庭能够至少在饮用水方面，从高砷水井转而使用邻近的低砷水井。我们通过在2008年对2005年曾接受访问的Araihazar地区一个随机抽取的家庭子样本进行重访，研究了井水转换行为随时间的动态变化。与人们担心砷信息对转换行为的影响会随时间消退的观点相反，我们发现，2003至2005年间的水井转换不仅高度持续，而且到2008年，新的转换行为使仍在使用不安全水井的家庭中已转换水井的比例翻了一番。时间的推移也带来了代价：到2008年，22%的家庭已不记得检测结果。砷知识的流失导致家庭继续使用不安全水井，并从安全水井转向不安全水井。我们的结果支持持续开展砷水井检测，以强化这一有益信息。

title: Promoting clean energy investment: An empirical analysis of property assessed clean energy
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: From 2008 to 2010 a handful of Property-Assessed Clean Energy (PACE) programs offered property-secured loans to homeowners for residential clean energy investments. This analysis uses difference-in-differences models and synthetic counterfactual models to estimate the effect of three California PACE programs on residential photovoltaic installations. While PACE programs do not offer superior terms to other solar financing options, we find that PACE financing increases solar installations by approximately 3.8. watts per owner-occupied household per quarter, a 108% increase over the mean watts per owner-occupied household.
abstract_zh: 2008年至2010年间，少数几个“物业评估清洁能源”（PACE）计划向房主提供以房产作担保的贷款，用于住宅清洁能源投资。本文采用双重差分模型和合成反事实模型，估计了加利福尼亚州三个PACE计划对住宅光伏装机的影响。尽管PACE计划提供的条款并不优于其他太阳能融资选择，但我们发现，PACE融资使每个自住家庭每季度的太阳能装机容量增加约3.8瓦，相当于自住家庭平均瓦数增加108%。

title: Spatial-dynamics of hypoxia and fisheries: The case of Gulf of Mexico brown shrimp
venue: Marine Resource Economics
abstract: We analyze the Gulf of Mexico brown shrimp fishery and the potential impacts of a large seasonal area of hypoxia (low dissolved oxygen) that coincides with the peak shrimp season. A spatial-dynamic bioeconomic simulation embeds three biological impacts on shrimp: mortality, growth, and aggregation on hypoxic edges. Hypoxia creates feedbacks in the bioeconomic system, altering catch and effort patterns. System changes propagate over space to affect areas that do not experience hypoxia. Areas that might otherwise be considered controls in a natural experiments framework are contaminated by the ecological disturbance through spatial sorting. Aggregate predictions from simulations are similar to empirical fishery data. Average shrimp size and total landings are negatively correlated, as are hypoxic severity and landings. Shrimp size and hypoxic severity are only weakly negatively correlated. Growth overfishing, which varies with recruitment success and ecological disturbances, is a key mediating effect.
abstract_zh: 我们分析墨西哥湾棕虾渔业，以及与虾类捕捞旺季重合的大规模季节性缺氧区（低溶解氧）可能产生的影响。一个空间动态生物经济模拟纳入了缺氧对虾类的三种生物学影响：死亡、生长以及在缺氧边缘的聚集。缺氧会在生物经济系统中产生反馈，改变捕获量和捕捞努力的格局。系统变化会通过空间传播，影响那些并未经历缺氧的区域。在自然实验框架下原本可能被视为对照组的区域，会因空间分选而受到生态扰动的污染。模拟得到的总体预测与实证渔业数据相近。平均虾体型与总渔获量呈负相关，缺氧严重程度与渔获量也呈负相关。虾体型与缺氧严重程度之间的负相关则较弱。生长型过度捕捞（growth overfishing）是一个关键的中介效应，它随补充成功率和生态扰动而变化。

title: Will a catch share for whales improve social welfare?
venue: Ecological applications : a publication of the Ecological Society of America
abstract: We critique a proposal to use catch shares to manage transboundary wildlife resources with potentially high non‐extractive values, and we focus on the case of whales. Because whales are impure public goods, a policy that fails to capture all nonmarket benefits (due to free riding) could lead to a suboptimal outcome. Even if free riding were overcome, whale shares would face four implementation challenges. First, a whale share could legitimize the international trade in whale meat and expand the whale meat market. Second, a legal whale trade creates monitoring and enforcement challenges similar to those of organizations that manage highly migratory species such as tuna. Third, a whale share could create a new political economy of management that changes incentives and increases costs for nongovernmental organizations (NGOs) to achieve the current level of conservation. Fourth, a whale share program creates new logistical challenges for quota definition and allocation regardless of whether the market for whale products expands or contracts. Each of these issues, if left unaddressed, could result in lower overall welfare for society than under the status quo.
abstract_zh: 我们对一项提议提出批评，该提议拟采用渔获份额（catch share）来管理可能具有很高非开采性价值的跨界野生动物资源，本文以鲸鱼为例进行讨论。由于鲸鱼是不纯公共物品，若政策因搭便车而未能捕获全部非市场收益，则可能导致次优结果。即使克服了搭便车问题，鲸鱼渔获份额仍将面临四项实施挑战。第一，鲸鱼份额可能使鲸肉的国际贸易合法化，并扩大鲸肉市场。第二，合法的鲸鱼贸易会带来与管理金枪鱼等高度洄游物种的组织类似的监测与执法挑战。第三，鲸鱼份额可能形成一种新的管理政治经济结构，改变非政府组织（NGO）维持当前保护水平的激励并增加其成本。第四，无论鲸制品市场是扩张还是收缩，鲸鱼份额计划都会在配额的界定与分配方面带来新的后勤挑战。上述每一个问题如果得不到解决，都可能使社会总福利低于现状。

title: Municipal rebate programs for environmental retrofits: An evaluation of additionality and cost-effectiveness
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: When policies incentivize voluntary activities that also take place in the absence of the incentive, it is critical to identify the additionality of the policy-that is, the degree to which the policy results in actions that would not have occurred otherwise. Rebate programs have become a common conservation policy tool for local municipalities seeking to retrofit residential properties with efficient appliances. This research evaluates whether such rebates can be cost-effective means for water utilities to promote water conservation. A unique database is developed that combines water-use data over a three-year period for all households that participated in a utility's high-efficiency toilet (HET) rebate program, water-use data for a matched sample of neighbors who did not receive a rebate, and a survey of rebate participants. Difference-in-differences models indicate that installation of an HET reduces household water consumption by approximately 7 percent. While installation of an HET appears to be an effective means for achieving household reductions in water consumption, our results also suggest that the rebate program is a much less effective means for achieving household reductions in water consumption. Specifically, the rebate program is found to provide limited additional water savings beyond what would have occurred naturally and is responsible for only 37 percent of the total water reduction attributable to the installation of HETs over the study period. © 2013 by the Association for Public Policy Analysis and Management.
abstract_zh: 当政策激励的是那些在没有激励时同样会发生的自愿性行为时，识别政策的额外性（additionality），即政策在多大程度上促成了原本不会发生的行动，就变得至关重要。返还计划已成为地方政府为住宅配备高效家电而常用的保护政策工具。本研究评估此类返还计划是否可以成为供水公司促进节水的成本效益手段。我们构建了一个独特的数据库，其中包括：某供水公司高效马桶（HET）返还计划所有参与家庭三年期的用水数据，一组未获返还的匹配邻居样本的用水数据，以及对返还计划参与者的调查。双重差分模型表明，安装HET使家庭用水量减少约7%。尽管安装HET似乎是实现家庭节水的有效手段，但我们的结果也表明，返还计划在实现家庭节水方面的效果要差得多。具体而言，返还计划只带来了有限的额外节水，超出了原本会自然发生的部分，并且在研究期间，它仅对因安装HET而实现的总节水量负责37%。© 2013，公共政策分析与管理协会（Association for Public Policy Analysis and Management）版权所有。

title: Impact of a randomized controlled trial in arsenic risk communication on household water-source choices in Bangladesh
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: We conducted a randomized controlled trial in rural Bangladesh to examine how household drinking-water choices were affected by two different messages about risk from naturally occurring groundwater arsenic. Households in both randomized treatment arms were informed about the arsenic level in their well and whether that level was above or below the Bangladesh standard for arsenic. Households in one group of villages were encouraged to seek water from wells below the national standard. Households in the second group of villages received additional information explaining that lower-arsenic well water is always safer and these households were encouraged to seek water from wells with lower levels of arsenic, irrespective of the national standard.A simple model of household drinking-water choice indicates that the effect of the emphasis message is theoretically ambiguous. Empirically, we find that the richer message had a negative, but insignificant, effect on well-switching rates, but the estimates are sufficiently precise that we can rule out large positive effects. The main policy implication of this finding is that a one-time oral message conveying richer information on arsenic risks, while inexpensive and easily scalable, is unlikely to be successful in reducing exposure relative to the status-quo policy.
abstract_zh: 我们在孟加拉国农村开展了一项随机对照试验，以考察两种关于天然地下水砷风险的不同信息如何影响家庭的饮用水选择。两个随机处理组的家庭都被告知其水井中的砷含量，以及该含量是高于还是低于孟加拉国的砷标准。其中一组村庄的家庭被鼓励从低于国家标准的水井取水。第二组村庄的家庭则额外获得了说明，即砷含量较低的井水总是更安全，并且这些家庭被鼓励从砷含量较低的水井取水，而不论其是否符合国家标准。一个简单的家庭饮用水选择模型表明，强调信息的效应在理论上是不确定的。从实证上看，我们发现，较丰富的信息对水井转换率的影响为负，但不显著，不过估计值足够精确，因此我们可以排除较大的正向效应。这一发现的主要政策含义是：一次性口头传达较丰富的砷风险信息，虽然成本低廉且易于推广，但相对于现行政策，它在降低暴露水平方面不太可能成功。

title: Participation Incentives, Rebound Effects and the Cost-Effectiveness of Rebates for Water-Efficient Appliances
venue: Duke Environmental Economics Working Paper
abstract: Rebate programs for retrofitting residential properties with water efficient appliances have become a common conservation policy tool for local municipalities. Engineering estimates of water savings from rebate programs can be systematically biased because they assume all subsidized appliance replacements would not have occurred in the absence of the subsidy and because they fail to account for potential rebound effects. We partner with a water utility in North Carolina to develop a unique database that combines water use data over a three-year period for all households that participated in the utility’s high efficiency toilet (HET) rebate program, water use data for a matched sample of neighbors, and a survey of rebate participants. We evaluate whether rebates are a cost- effective means for water utilities to promote water conservation accounting for both selection and rebound effects. Difference-in-differences estimators indicate no evidence of a rebound effect with HET installation. However, we find that water savings attributable to the rebate program are less than one-half the actual savings associated with an HET installation. Costs of saving water through toilet replacements are estimated to be between $5.50 and $11.00 per 1,000 gallons which compares favorably to costs of raw water through purchasing or expansion which are between $7.00-$11.00 per 1,000 gallons.
abstract_zh: 为住宅配备节水型家电的返还计划已成为地方政府常用的保护政策工具。对返还计划节水量的工程估计可能存在系统性偏差，因为这些估计假定所有获补贴的家电更换若无补贴便不会发生，并且未能考虑潜在的反弹效应。我们与北卡罗来纳州的一家供水公司合作，构建了一个独特的数据库，其中包括：该公司高效马桶（HET）返还计划所有参与家庭三年期的用水数据，一组匹配邻居样本的用水数据，以及对返还计划参与者的调查。我们在同时考虑选择效应和反弹效应的情况下，评估返还计划对于供水公司促进节水是否具有成本效益。双重差分估计量显示，安装HET并未出现反弹效应的证据。然而，我们发现，归因于返还计划的节水量还不到安装HET实际节水量的一半。通过更换马桶节水的成本估计为每1000加仑5.50至11.00美元，与通过购买或扩建获取原水的成本（每1000加仑7.00至11.00美元）相比更具优势。

title: Sampling out: regulatory avoidance and the Total Coliform Rule
venue: Environmental science & technology
abstract: This paper investigates strategic noncompliance with the Total Coliform Rule (TCR) under the U.S. Safe Drinking Water Act. The structure of the TCR provides incentives for some piped drinking water systems to avoid violations by taking additional water quality samples. We estimate the prevalence of this behavior and its potential impact on violations using monthly data for more than 500 Massachusetts water systems, 1993-2003. We find evidence that strategic oversampling is occurring. Water systems most likely to avoid violations by oversampling are most likely to oversample. A significant number of additional violations would have occurred if systems had adhered to legal sampling requirements, rather than oversampling. Our analysis of potential impacts of regulatory avoidance under the current rule suggests that alternative policies for monitoring bacteria in drinking water should be considered.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国《安全饮用水法》下《总大肠菌群规则》（TCR）中的战略性不合规行为。TCR的结构使部分管道供水系统有动机通过额外采集水质样本来避免违规。我们利用1993年至2003年马萨诸塞州500多个供水系统的月度数据，估计了这一行为的普遍程度及其对违规的潜在影响。我们发现战略性过度采样确实存在的证据。最有可能通过过度采样来避免违规的供水系统，也最有可能进行过度采样。若这些系统遵守法定的采样要求，而非进行过度采样，将会出现大量额外的违规。我们对现行规则下规避管制的潜在影响所作的分析表明，应当考虑饮用水细菌监测的替代政策。

title: The impacts of the "right to know": Information disclosure and the violation of drinking water standards

title: What do we really know? The effect of reporting thresholds on inferences using environmental right‐to‐know data
venue: Regulation & Governance
abstract: Environmental right‐to‐know regulations require regulated entities to publicly disclose measures of environmental performance but exempt entities from these disclosure requirements if they manufacture, process, or use a chemical below some threshold level. Environmental right‐to‐know data are widely used to assess environmental performance by academics, regulators, non‐profit organizations, and the public. This paper uses data from Massachusetts to estimate the effect of reporting thresholds in environmental right‐to‐know programs on the validity of inferences using data from these programs. The analysis indicates that errors in inference introduced by reporting thresholds may be significant. Up to 40% of the observed decline in reported toxic releases in Massachusetts may be attributed to non‐reporting due to the reporting thresholds. In addition, quartile rankings of facilities may be in error up to 45% of the time when behavior around the reporting thresholds is not taken into account.
abstract_zh: 环境知情权（right-to-know）法规要求受监管实体公开披露环境绩效指标，但如果其制造、加工或使用某种化学品的量低于某一阈值，则可免于这些披露要求。环境知情权数据被学术界、监管机构、非营利组织和公众广泛用于评估环境绩效。本文利用马萨诸塞州的数据，估计环境知情权计划中的报告阈值对基于这些计划数据所作推断的有效性的影响。分析表明，报告阈值所引入的推断误差可能相当显著。马萨诸塞州所观察到的有毒物质排放报告量下降中，最多可能有40%可归因于因报告阈值而导致的不报告。此外，若不考虑报告阈值附近的行为，设施的四分位排名可能有多达45%的时间是错误的。

title: Are management-based regulations effective? evidence from state pollution prevention programs
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: This paper evaluates the effectiveness of management-based regulations in reducing pollution. Management-based regulations do not establish strict pollution reduction standards, but rather require each regulated entity to engage in its own review and planning process and develop a set of internal rules and initiatives consistent with achieving reductions in pollution. I develop a model of facility-level response to management-based regulation that provides predictions about the circumstances under which these regulations are likely to be effective. I then test these predictions empirically by taking advantage of a natural policy experiment that occurred when fourteen states adopted management-based regulations for toxic chemical control in the 1990s. Using panel data for just over 31,000 manufacturing plants in the United States, I investigate whether facilities subject to management-based regulations had larger changes in total quantities of toxic chemical releases, engaged in more pollution prevention activities, or reported fewer toxic chemicals to the Toxics Release Inventory. The analysis suggests that management-based regulation has had a measurable positive effect on the environmental performance of manufacturing plants. In particular, plants subject to management-based regulation experienced larger decreases in total pounds of toxic chemicals released and were more likely to engage in source reduction activities.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了基于管理的监管在减少污染方面的有效性。基于管理的监管并不设定严格的减污标准，而是要求每个受监管实体开展自身的审查与规划过程，并制定一套与实现减污相一致的内部规则和举措。我构建了一个关于设施层面对基于管理的监管作出反应的模型，该模型对这些监管在何种情况下可能有效作出了预测。随后，我利用一次自然政策实验对这些预测进行了实证检验，该实验发生于20世纪90年代，当时有十四个州为有毒化学品控制采用了基于管理的监管。利用美国略超过31000家制造工厂的面板数据，我考察了受基于管理的监管约束的设施在有毒化学品排放总量上是否变化更大，是否开展了更多的污染预防活动，以及是否向有毒物质排放清单（TRI）报告了更少的有毒化学品。分析表明，基于管理的监管对制造工厂的环境绩效产生了可测量的正面影响。具体而言，受基于管理的监管约束的工厂，其有毒化学品排放总量下降幅度更大，并且更有可能开展源头削减活动。

title: Second-best theory and the use of multiple policy instruments
venue: Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: In many cases policy makers employ multiple instruments to address a single environmental problem, but much of the economics literature on instrument choice focuses on comparing properties of single policy instruments. We argue that under a fairly broad set of circumstances the use of multiple policy instruments can be justified as optimal in a second-best world. We examine two broad categories of second-best policy making: cases with multiple market failures only some of which can be corrected at any one time; and cases with exogenous (often political) constraints that cannot be removed. The fact that the use of multiple policy instruments can be justified economically in these two cases does not imply, however, that all multiple instruments employed in actual practice are economically justified. © 2007 Springer Science+Business Media, Inc.
abstract_zh: 在许多情况下，政策制定者会使用多种工具来解决同一个环境问题，但大量关于工具选择的经济学文献都侧重于比较单一政策工具的性质。我们认为，在相当广泛的情形下，在次优世界中使用多种政策工具可以被论证为最优的。我们考察了次优政策制定的两大类情形：一是存在多重市场失灵，但在任一时点只能纠正其中一部分；二是存在无法消除的外生（往往是政治性的）约束。然而，在这两类情形下，多种政策工具的使用在经济上可以得到论证，并不意味着实践中采用的所有多种工具都具有经济上的合理性。© 2007，Springer Science+Business Media, Inc.版权所有。

title: Using revealed preferences to infer environmental benefits: Evidence from recreational fishing licenses
venue: Journal of Regulatory Economics
abstract: We develop and apply a new method for estimating the economic benefits of an environmental amenity. The method is based upon the notion of estimating the derived demand for a privately traded option to utilize an open access good. In particular, the demand for state fishing licenses is used to infer the benefits of recreational fishing. Using panel data on state fishing license sales and prices for the continental United States over a 15-year period, combined with data on substitute prices and demographic variables, a license demand function is estimated with instrumental variable procedures to allow for the potential endogeneity of administered prices. The econometric results lead to estimates of the benefits of a fishing license, and subsequently to the expected benefits of a recreational fishing day. In contrast with previous studies, which have utilized travel cost or hypothetical market methods, our approach provides estimates that are directly comparable across geographic areas. Our findings show substantial variation in the value of a recreational fishing day across geographic areas in the United States. This suggests that current practice of using benefits estimates from one part of the country in national or regional analyses may lead to substantial bias in benefits estimates. © 2005 Springer Science+Business Media, Inc.
abstract_zh: 我们提出并应用了一种估计环境舒适物经济效益的新方法。该方法基于这样一种思路：估计对利用某一开放获取商品的、可私人交易的选择权的派生需求。具体而言，我们利用州级捕鱼许可证的需求来推断休闲渔业的效益。利用美国大陆各州15年间的捕鱼许可证销售量与价格面板数据，并结合替代品价格和人口统计变量，我们采用工具变量方法估计了许可证需求函数，以考虑行政定价可能存在的内生性。计量结果得出了捕鱼许可证的效益估计，进而得出休闲捕鱼一日的预期效益。与以往采用旅行成本法或假设市场法的研究不同，我们的方法所得估计值可以在不同地理区域之间直接比较。我们的研究发现，美国各地区休闲捕鱼一日的价值存在显著差异。这表明，目前在全国或区域分析中使用来自国内某一地区的效益估计，可能会导致效益估计出现显著偏差。© 2005，Springer Science+Business Media, Inc.版权所有。

title: Strategic Response to Regulatory Thresholds: Evidence from the Massachusetts Toxics Use Reduction Act
The effects of environmental regulation on technology diffusion: The case of chlorine manufacturing
venue: American Economic Review
abstract: We use a hazard model to estimate the effect of environmental regulation on the diffusion of membrane cell production technology in the chlorine manufacturing industry. We estimate the effect of regulation on both the adoption of the membrane technology at existing plants and on the exit of existing plants using older technologies. We find that environmental regulation did affect the diffusion of the cleaner technology in the chlorine industry. However, it did so not by encouraging the adoption of membrane cells by existing facilities, but by reducing the demand for chlorine and hence encouraging the shutdown of facilities using the environmentally inferior options.
abstract_zh: 我们使用风险模型（hazard model）估计环境规制对氯碱制造行业隔膜电解槽生产技术扩散的影响。我们既估计了规制对现有工厂采用隔膜技术的影响，也估计了其对仍使用较旧技术的现有工厂退出的影响。我们发现，环境规制确实影响了氯碱行业中更清洁技术的扩散。然而，它并非通过鼓励现有设施采用隔膜电解槽来实现这一点，而是通过减少对氯的需求，从而促使使用环境性能较差技术的设施关停。

title: Every breath you take ... ": The demographics of toxic air releases in Southern California
venue: Economic Development Quarterly
abstract: In this article, the authors investigate the relationship between ethnicity and potential environmental hazards in the metropolitan Los Angeles area. Using a variety of techniques, including geographic information systems (GIS) mapping, univariate comparisons, and logit, ordered logit, and tobit regression analysis, the authors find that, even controlling for other factors such as income and the extent of manufacturing employment and land use, minority residents tend to be disproportionately located in neighborhoods surrounding toxic air emissions. The results generally support the propositions of the proponents of “environmental justice”; in the conclusion, they consider what this might mean for urban land use and environmental policy.
abstract_zh: 本文作者考察了洛杉矶大都会区族裔与潜在环境危害之间的关系。作者综合运用多种方法，包括地理信息系统（GIS）制图、单变量比较，以及logit、有序logit和tobit回归分析，发现即使控制了收入、制造业就业程度和土地利用等其他因素，少数族裔居民仍倾向于不成比例地居住在有毒空气排放物周边的社区。结果总体上支持“环境正义”（environmental justice）倡导者的主张；在结论部分，作者探讨了这对城市土地利用和环境政策可能意味着什么。

title: Is there environmental racism? The demographics of hazardous waste in Los Angeles County
venue: Social Science Quarterly
abstract: Objective. The "environmental justice" movement has suggested that demographic inequities characterize the location of hazardous waste treatment, storage, and disposal facilities (TSDFs). While some researchers have found evidence that TSDFs are disproportionately located in minority areas, others attribute TSDF location to nonracial factors such as income and industrial employment. Methods. We used both univariate and multivariate techniques to analyze the location of TSDFs in Los Angeles County, California; the focus on one county allowed us to overcome the problem of "false" addresses for TSDF sites and to introduce specific land use/zoning variables that are not used in the other studies. Results. In our univariate results and the multivariate model, we find that (1) industrial land use and manufacturing employment do matter, as suggested by critics of environmental justice; (2) income has first a positive, then a negative effect on TSDF location, a pattern that likely reflects the fact that the poorest communities have little economic activity while wealthier communities have the economic and political power to resist negative environmental externalities; and (3) race and ethnicity are still significantly associated with TSDF location, even when percentage African American and percentage Latino are evaluated as separate groupings. Taken together, the results suggest that communities most affected by TSDFs in the Los Angeles area are working-class communities of color located near industrial areas.
abstract_zh: 目的。“环境正义”运动认为，有害废物处理、储存和处置设施（TSDF）的选址体现了人口结构上的不平等。虽然一些研究者发现有证据表明TSDF不成比例地位于少数族裔地区，但另一些人则将TSDF的选址归因于收入和工业就业等非种族因素。方法。我们使用单变量和多变量方法，分析了加利福尼亚州洛杉矶县TSDF的选址；将研究聚焦于一个县，使我们得以克服TSDF场址“虚假”地址的问题，并引入其他研究未使用的特定土地利用/分区变量。结果。在单变量结果和多变量模型中，我们发现：（1）工业用地和制造业就业确实重要，正如环境正义的批评者所指出的那样；（2）收入对TSDF选址先有正向影响、后有负向影响，这一模式很可能反映了一个事实：最贫困的社区经济活动很少，而较富裕的社区则拥有经济和政治力量来抵制负面环境外部性；（3）即使将非裔美国人百分比和拉丁裔百分比作为单独的分组进行评估，种族和族裔仍与TSDF选址显著相关。综合来看，结果表明，洛杉矶地区受TSDF影响最大的社区，是位于工业区附近的有色人种工薪阶层社区。
